name: Adena
description: The primary circulating gold currency of Lineage II, dropped by all monsters and required for all basic town services, teleports, skills, and consumable purchases.

sinks: World Trade registration fee (100% of price in Adena)
Aden Laboratory research fees (10,000,000 adena per attempt)
Skill Enchantment fees (1,000,000 adena per roll + 3,000,000 for SP Pouch)
Doll compounding fees (100,000 adena per common attempt)

notes: Core economic stabilizer. Sinks must balance faucets to prevent hyperinflation.

name: L-Coin
description: Specialized currency used to purchase premium items, talismans, enchant scrolls, doll summons, and runic catalysts from the L-Coin Store and World Trade.
notes: In Essence, L-Coins partially replaced traditional monetization by being droppable/earnable via daily missions.

name: Eva's Points / Eva Coins
description: Special non-monetized server currency earned through gameplay on Project Eva servers to purchase items from Eva's Shop without cash shop dependence.

sinks: Eva's Shop: Growth Rune Lv 1 (4,500 Eva Points + 1M Adena)

notes: Represents the player-friendly, non-P2W economic model of Lineage II Essence.

name: Skill Points (SP)
description: Points accrued alongside EXP from monster kills, consumed to learn active and passive class skills and absorb experience into SP Pouches for Skill Enchanting.

faucets: Magic Lamp rolls (Green/Purple lamps grant massive SP)

notes: In Aden Arena, SP is a core gating resource ensuring players strategically prioritize skill upgrades.
